mapper.insert: INSERT INTO doc_file_version (file_id, version_no, original_name, stored_name, path, size, uploader_id, uploader_name) VALUES (#{fileId}, #{versionNo}, #{originalName}, #{storedName}, #{path}, #{size}, #{uploaderId}, #{uploaderName})
mapper.select: SELECT version_id, file_id, version_no, original_name, stored_name, path, size, uploader_id, uploader_name, update_time FROM doc_file_version WHERE file_id = #{fileId} ORDER BY version_no DESC
